mods.name: Too Many Emotes
mods.summary: Hundreds of full-body emotes and dances for Build 42, ported from FlipMods' TooManyEmotes (Lethal Company).
description: Every emote is unlocked and reachable from the vanilla emote wheel (Too Many Emotes slice) or from a searchable emote browser with favorites.
Animations are retargeted from the original Unity humanoid clips onto the Project Zomboid skeleton, fingers included.
mods.credits: Original emotes and animations: FlipMods, TooManyEmotes (MIT license).

loops.title: Emote loops
